title: Real Research Today: Electromagnetic Mass Drivers
definition: Today's documented research behind Electromagnetic Mass Drivers.
description:
The road to Electromagnetic Mass Drivers is already being paved. Autonomous shipping trials (Yara Birkeland, MAS) test crewless cargo vessels. SpaceX Starship targets fully reusable heavy lift, the prerequisite for point-to-point rocket travel.

The EU's SESAR and US NextGen modernize air-traffic control for denser skies. Together these programs form the coil arrays foundation that Electromagnetic Mass Drivers will build on — the driver logistics results, the power pulses methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as driver logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Electromagnetic Mass Drivers Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Electromagnetic Mass Drivers: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Electromagnetic Mass Drivers — railguns launching cargo to orbit.

Phase 1 — Prove (coil arrays): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (driver logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (power pulses): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (payload hardening): driver hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and launch-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
